mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wb_setting (setting_id, user_id, setting_key, setting_value, value_type, updated_by, updated_at) VALUES (#{settingId}, #{userId}, #{settingKey}, #{settingValue}, #{valueType}, #{updatedBy}, now()) ON CONFLICT (user_id, setting_key) DO UPDATE SET setting_value = #{settingValue}, value_type = #{valueType}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = now()
